incoming_db_defensive_impact.definition: sum of prior DB defensive impact for incoming DB transfers; each player impact is the frozen equal-weight mean of within-season x DB-group standardized log1p tackles, passes defended, and interceptions
incoming_db_defensive_impact.historical_evaluation_caveat: retrospective research reconstruction for seasons before the production snapshot process existed
incoming_db_defensive_impact.source: production preseason transfer-feature artifact derived from frozen portal, prior roster, and defensive game-player snapshots

incoming_prior_offensive_usage.historical_evaluation_caveat: retrospective research reconstruction for seasons before the production snapshot process existed
incoming_prior_offensive_usage.source: production preseason transfer-feature artifact derived from frozen portal + prior usage snapshots

recruiting.caveat: historical values are retrospective endpoint reconstructions, not archived snapshots
